text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back from training outside the academy—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
*Cough, cough*... The one thing I'll never get used to is all this traffic.
Man, I miss the fresh country air—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Whew, that was close.
Almost took a face full of exhaust fumes there.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
What? Wanna hold hands all the way home like this?
Haha, just kidding, just kidding!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Was that a bit of an exaggeration? But hey, exhaust fumes like that aren't good for your health, right?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
*Cough*...
Ugh... Seriously, that smell gives me a headache.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stench was so overpowering
that Katsuragi Ace was left with a pounding headache...
